LanguageData.FedaykinStillsuit.label: stillsuit (fedaykin)
LanguageData.FedaykinStillsuit.description: The Stillsuit was designed as a complete body filtration device. Several layers work together to recycle perspiration and bodily waste to preserve water. An efficient stillsuit will lose only a thimbelfull of water a day. This stillsuit is slightly enhanced with additional armor plates for added combat effectiveness.
LanguageData.Fremen_Mask.label: fremen stillsuit mask
LanguageData.Fremen_Mask.description: A facial apparatus designed to filter and recycle the water expelled whilst breathing. Without this apparatus, the stillsuit would only operate at around 80% efficiency.
